themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform complex research tasks, interact with systems, and execute multi-step workflows autonomously.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, review, and understand code, often integrated into IDEs.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and applications designed to assist with various aspects of the research process.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated user personas, data, or interactions to simulate real user behavior for testing and analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Details AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, research findings, or meeting transcripts into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze customer reviews, feedback, and social media to gauge public opinion and sentiment.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that directly aid in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to UI generation and system design.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Involves AI tools and techniques for automating software testing, quality assurance, and verification processes.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, and rank different AI-powered research tools and platforms.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Examines the impact of AI on job markets, hiring processes, and the skills required for future workforces.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
